capabilities: Create many notes at once in a selected folder
Create additional subfolders during bulk creation
Duplicate an existing file's content into each new note via a template option
Run creation from a folder's right-click menu or the command palette
extras: The README notes the community plugin directory listing is only 'when available' and gives manual installation steps, suggesting it may not yet be published there.
problem: Obsidian creates notes one at a time, so setting up many files in advance is slow and repetitive.
summary: Bulk note creation tool that generates many files at once in a chosen folder, with optional subfolders and content copied from a template file.
